# Theekshana Sudeepa — Software Engineer Portfolio

> Official personal portfolio of Theekshana Sudeepa, a Software Engineer specializing in TypeScript, React 19, UI/UX engineering, AI/MCP integrations, WSO2/Asgardeo IAM, and Enterprise Java (Jakarta EE 10 / Hibernate 6) from Colombo, Sri Lanka.

- Canonical URL: https://theekshana-sudeepa.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/theekshana-sudeepa/
- Location: Colombo, Sri Lanka
- Education: BSc (Hons) in Software Engineering (Final Stage, Birmingham City University / JIAT); UK Level 5 Higher Diploma & Level 4 Diploma in Software Engineering.

## Production Impact & Open Source

- Inner Mental Wellness (Corporate EAP): Architected Sri Lanka's first Employee Assistance Program serving 50+ organizations with anonymous therapy booking, browser consultations, organization analytics, and Stripe Webhook billing.
- Lexora Workspace (33-Tool Web Suite): Engineered a responsive 33-tool browser productivity and developer suite focused on sub-second client-side UX and clean component architecture.
- WSO2 Open-Source Contributions: Contributed documentation improvements to WSO2 API Manager (`wso2/docs-apim`) alongside a React 19 & TypeScript OIDC PKCE / RS256 JWKS integration demo for WSO2 IS & Asgardeo.

## Core Engineering Expertise

- TypeScript, React & UI/UX Engineering: Strict TypeScript, React 19, Next.js 16, Vite 8, offline-first PWAs, design systems, and accessible responsive interfaces.
- AI-Native Integrations & MCP: Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integrations, Vercel AI SDK orchestration, and automated document/catalog OCR pipelines.
- Enterprise Java, WSO2 & IAM: Jakarta EE 10, EJB 4.0, Hibernate 6 ORM, WSO2 Identity Server / Asgardeo OIDC PKCE, stateless RS256 JWKS verification, RBAC, and JSR-356 WebSockets.
- Full-Stack APIs, Cloud & Mobile: Express, Prisma ORM, MySQL 8, PostgreSQL, AWS/OCI Infrastructure-as-Code, Docker, and React Native (Expo).

## Featured Open-Source & Production Systems

- [Kasa](https://kasa-theta.vercel.app) ([GitHub](https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa/kasa)): Trilingual AI shopping concierge built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Vercel AI SDK, and Kapruka MCP.
- [Sillara](https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa/sillara): Offline-first, multi-tenant POS PWA and B2B retail supply network with React 19, TypeScript, Express, Prisma, MySQL 8, and AI catalog OCR.
- [AutoBilling](https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa/autobilling): Idempotent recurring billing, PDF invoicing, and automated payment chasing engine with React 19, TypeScript, Express, Prisma, MySQL, and AWS/OCI IaC.
- [WSO2 Identity & Asgardeo Integration Demo](https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa/wso2-identity-integration-demo): React 19 & TypeScript CIAM integration featuring OIDC PKCE, stateless RS256 JWKS verification, RBAC middleware, and Docker, alongside contributions to [wso2/docs-apim](https://github.com/wso2/docs-apim).
- [GlobalTrade SCM](https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa/globaltrade-scm): Modular Jakarta EE 10 supply chain platform with EJB 4.0, Hibernate 6, JWT RBAC, CDI interceptors, and WildFly 31+.
- [Nimithi Platform](https://www.nimithi.com/): Bilingual (Sinhala & English) Vedic astronomical platform calculating planetary positions and Panchanga from Swiss Ephemeris data.
- [Tappsy Messaging Suite](https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa/Tappsy): Real-time cross-platform mobile messaging app (React Native / Expo SDK 54, TypeScript) paired with [TappsyBackEnd](https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa/TappsyBackEnd) (Java EE JSR-356 WebSockets, Hibernate, MySQL 8).
- [Overdraft Roguelite](https://github.com/theekshana-sudeepa/overdraft-roguelite): Deterministic 60 Hz Unity C# twin-stick roguelite with zero-GC hot paths and a physics-free counting-sort spatial grid.
